message: `aria-relevant="removals"` on the part sets the live region of `error` otherwise than its role does
$reason: An error part with its `alert` and `aria-relevant="removals"`. Both engines expose the relevance as written in place of the `additions text` the role implies (measured on 2026-10-27: Chromium 153 `relevant`, Firefox 158 `container-relevant`), and NVDA announces nothing of a region whose relevance names neither `additions` nor `text`: the text of a message that changes while shown is not a change the region reports. Point 7 read the part's role and politeness and what may hide it, and passed it.
